name: Default
shortDescription: Stealth Chromium with source-level fingerprint patches, served by cloakserve as a Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint for Playwright and Puppeteer automation.

alerts.message: This variant runs the 0.6 line, which ships a keyless Chromium 146 build inside the image and needs no account. Setting CLOAKBROWSER_LICENSE_KEY in the environment settings (a free key takes an email) makes it download and use the latest licensed build instead.

cloakserve has no authentication of its own, so every request goes through a gateway that requires an Authorization: Bearer header with the generated CLOAKBROWSER_TOKEN from the environment settings. With Playwright: connect_over_cdp("https://<your-domain>", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <token>"}). Puppeteer does not send headers when it fetches browserURL, so read webSocketDebuggerUrl from /json/version yourself and pass it as browserWSEndpoint with the same headers.
